def width_along(p0,p1,label):
    p0=np.array(p0,float); p1=np.array(p1,float)
    d=p1-p0; L=np.hypot(*d); u=d/L
    n=np.array([-u[1],u[0]])
    print(f"{label}: from {p0} to {p1}")
    for t in [0.12,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.88]:
